title: SearXNG web search
description: Query a self-hosted SearXNG meta-search instance and return normalized web results (title, url, content, engine). Useful as a lightweight, self-hosted alternative to commercial search APIs and as the search backend next to a local Firecrawl deployment.

baseUrl.description: SearXNG base URL without a trailing slash. The instance must allow the JSON output format (search.formats includes json).

engines.description: Comma-separated SearXNG engine names (for example brave,bing,duckduckgo). Empty string uses the instance default.

language.description: Default SearXNG language code (for example en or zh-CN). Empty string uses the instance default; a per-call language argument overrides it.

capabilities.title: Web search via SearXNG
capabilities.description: Run a web search through a self-hosted SearXNG instance and return normalized results. Failures are reported as ok:false JSON instead of crashing the shell capability.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-10).

language.description: Optional SearXNG language code; overrides the pack default.

checks.description: python syntax of the search executor
